highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.155 line updates HarfBuzz and refines image decoding and GLES interop support.
highlights_body: RAW and DNG decoding are disabled, while GLES interop moves to pointer-based signatures. Review affected integrations before adopting a prerelease.

bullets.detail: GLES consumers should update native interop code to use the new pointer-based signatures.
Applications that rely on bundled RAW or DNG decoding should provide an alternative image-decoding path.
The bundled text-shaping engine advances to HarfBuzz 14.4.0.
